combo_label: At the Supermarket × Bees & Beekeeping × Codes & Ciphers

entries.clue: Crumpled film left in your pocket after the chocolate bar is gone
Stacked wooden box in which bees are kept and honey is stored
German rotor machine whose traffic was broken in Buckinghamshire
Sticky tree resin gathered to seal cracks and varnish the nest
Long tube of a tongue unrolled to sip nectar from a flower
Cloth bib on strings, tied at the waist to keep flour off a white shirt
Guessed scrap of the original text used as a way in
Dots and dashes tapped out on a key
Black surface the car park is laid with, white bays painted over it
Stone whose three scripts unlocked the hieroglyphs
Sum of every item, announced when the last one has been rung up
Scribbled before you leave home, then ticked off item by item
